title: FRIDEKO HOME Floor Lamp with RGB Smart LED Bulb and Beige Lampshade
features: 【Modern Dimmable Floor Lamp】Minimalist and modern, this sleek LED floor lamp can be placed anywhere you like. The tall lamp comes with a linen lampshade and a sturdy black base, with a height of approx. 170cm. This standing lamp is perfect for the living room, bedroom or office, creating a wide range of atmospheres.

【Smart Control】This RGB floor lamp can be easily controlled via remote control, APP and foot switch. Simply tap the remote or mobile APP to adjust brightness, colour and mode to achieve your desired lighting effect. It also features an inline foot switch on the power cable, allowing you to turn the lamp on and off effortlessly with your feet, leaving your hands free.

【Dynamic RGB Multi-Colour Bulb】The floor lamps equipped with a 9W bulb. The colour temperature ranges from 2700–6500K (warm yellow, warm white, cool white and RGB), and brightness is adjustable from 0% to 100%. This standard lamp delivers abundant options for attractive colour combinations and smooth dynamic multi-colour effects to suit your needs.

【Multi-Functional Modes】This floor lamps for living room has a music sync light mode, which generates a light show that pulses to the rhythm of music and game audio, bringing stunning colour blends and soft dynamic multi-colour effects. The living room lamp also comes with a timer function to automatically turn the lamp on and off at set times.

【Easy to Assemble】The corner floor lamp is easy to set up—no extra tools are needed. Just follow the instructions to screw in all the parts. A great gift for office, house warming, college apartment move-in, Christmas, birthdays. (9W bulb included)
